prompt.zh-TW: 晨光補習班今年收到銀行定存的利息 {{money:vars.interest}}。這筆錢在損益表上屬於哪裡？它能不能說明補習班的本業變好了？
prompt.en: Morning Light Tutoring received {{money:vars.interest}} of interest on a bank deposit this year. Where does it belong on the income statement, and does it show that the tutoring business itself improved?

text.zh-TW: 營業外收入；它和教學本業無關，不能說明本業變好
text.en: Non-operating income; it has nothing to do with teaching and says nothing about the core business

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。利息來自存款，不是來自上課，放在營業利益之後。
feedback.en: Nice work. The interest comes from a deposit, not from lessons, and sits after operating profit.

short.zh-TW: 營業外收入，與本業無關
short.en: Non-operating income, unrelated to the core business

text.zh-TW: 營業收入；只要是補習班收到的錢都算
text.en: Revenue; any money the tutoring centre receives counts

feedback.zh-TW: 這筆錢確實是補習班收到的收益，這點沒錯。不過營業收入只放本業賺來的錢，也就是學費；存款利息是把錢存在銀行得到的，放營業外收入，才不會讓營業利益看起來比本業實際的成績好。
feedback.en: It is indeed income the centre received, that much is right. But revenue holds only what the core business earns, which here means tuition fees; deposit interest comes from money kept on deposit at the bank and goes under non-operating income, so that operating profit does not look better than the business really did.

text.zh-TW: 不用列在損益表上，因為它不是學費
text.en: It does not go on the income statement at all, because it is not tuition

feedback.zh-TW: 你看出它不是本業收入，這點沒錯。不過這類收益一樣要列進損益表，只是放的位置不同；利息收入列在營業外收入，一樣算進稅前淨利。
feedback.en: You can see it is not core revenue, which is right. But income like this still goes on the income statement; only the position differs. Interest income is shown under non-operating income and still counts towards profit before tax.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}}只放本業賺的錢，其他收益放{{term:tm_6nmfxa10}}，在{{term:tm_z3vbt800}}之後才加進來，所以答案是{{option:o_pze3}}。選{{option:o_tayf}}會讓營業利益失真，選{{option:o_f2hf}}則漏掉了一筆真實的收益。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} holds only what the core business earns; other gains go under {{term:tm_6nmfxa10}} and are added after {{term:tm_z3vbt800}}, so the answer is {{option:o_pze3}}. Choosing {{option:o_tayf}} would distort operating profit, and choosing {{option:o_f2hf}} leaves out a real gain.
